patch_list: Makes 'Restore Purchases' grant every store item for free (Ultimate Power, all classes, bundles and powers) — also removes ads.
Buy any item in the shop for free. When you tap Buy, the item is added to your game right away — no Google Play payment window ever opens.
Disables the PairIP license check so the game starts without Google Play licensing, error dialogs or forced exits.
